ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35% high-intensity white pixels to 65% low-intensity black pixels across visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Centrally concentrated white region with dark margins. Right lobe: White pigmentation concentrated on the distal tip and outer lateral edge, with dark pigmentation dominating the base and medial region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe irregular truncation and jagged tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe distal to the median line.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in pigmentation distribution and trailing edge structural integrity between left and right lobes.
